integrity: All stated infinite conclusions follow from the exact chord-gap decomposition and Ford’s published multiplication-table theorem. No independent review or external certification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Applies to one chord. Uses Ford’s established upper bound on multiplication-table cardinality. The resulting span exponent is not shown optimal. The existence of a completing single chord at every n is neither proved nor assumed. Finite tests do not prove asymptotics.
title: A polylogarithmic short-chord obstruction for consecutive cycle sums
